title: The Horse That Kept Coming Back
about: A childhood toy horse becomes a recurring Christmas surprise passed between cousins.
description: What began as an ordinary childhood gift refused to stay in the past. Years later, a familiar toy horse found its way back into the family's Christmas celebrations, passed between cousins and reimagined with every return. The Horse That Kept Coming Back tells the beginning of a long-running gift-giving tradition in which the wrapping becomes part of the present and each new year brings a chance to outdo the last. It is a story of creativity, teasing, and the memories that make even an old toy priceless.
lyrics: Verse 1
When I was just a little kid,
A Christmas gift came through,
A horse's head upon a stick,
With wheels to pull it through.
From my uncle's family,
A present meant for me,
Who would've thought that little horse,
Would make such history?Years went by, we all grew up,
That horse was from the past,
Until one Christmas Dillon said,
He wanted one at last.Refrain
And round and round the Christmas tree,
That old horse found its way,
From one of us to the other,
To return another day.Verse 2
I took that old familiar horse,
And made it part of his surprise,
Wrapped his present like a horse,
Right before his eyes.
I thought that was the end of it,
One clever Christmas trick,
But Dillon had a different plan,
For that old horse on a stick.He sent it right back to me,
And so the game began,
Each time that horse came home again,
We'd dream up one more plan.Refrain
And round and round the Christmas tree,
That old horse found its way,
From one of us to the other,
To return another day.Verse 3
Then Dillon took that horse one year,
And gave it something new,
A body built around the stick,
Like ancient soldiers knew.
A Trojan horse for Christmas,
A wooden-looking beast,
The little toy I'd had as a child,
Had grown, to say the least.And when it came around again,
I knew what I would do,
If he could make a Trojan horse,
I'd make the legend true.Final Chorus
The horse that kept coming back,
Had one more trick to show,
The moment that he pulled its head,
The soldiers dropped below!
And from the neck came parachutes,
Flying through the air,
A Christmas Trojan horse attack,
With soldiers everywhere!The horse that kept coming back,
From childhood to that day,
Every year a different trick,
And a new game left to play!Outro
It started as a little toy,
A horse upon a stick,
And turned into a Christmas war,
Of one more clever trick.
No matter how we wrapped it,
Or what we tried to do,
That horse was never just a horse,
When passed between us two.
